title: Sweetwater Farm
specs: Small community of experienced horse owners
Private and gated facility on 9 acres
Close proximity to highway 101 and quiet country lane
Facility not set up for horses under four years old, jumpers, reining, or cutting horses unless retired

options.name: Full-Service Horse Boarding
options.detail: Customized care and attention for 15-17 horses with daily turnout and feeding

variants.label: Customized care and attention for 15-17 horses with daily turnout and feeding

includes: Daily turnout in individual paddocks for 5-6 hours weather permitting
Three feedings per day with high quality orchard grass or orchard grass and timothy hay
Blanketing, unblanketing, fly spray, fly mask, and owner provided supplements included
Chronic medications given once daily by manager at boarder’s request
Final barn check each evening to ensure safety and normal behavior
Use of 18-stall barn with automatic watering, LED lighting, ceiling fans, tack rooms, wash rack
Access to arenas including 75 x 185 all weather sand arena with sprinkler system
blurb: Sweetwater Farm is a small, private horse boarding facility on 9 acres in north Santa Rosa. They board 15-17 horses with customized feeding, blanketing, and turnout programs. Facilities include an 18-stall barn, arenas, pastures, and free trailer parking.
